name: Horizontal press
twin_start: Start: lying back, hands at the chest, elbows bent about 80 degrees.
twin_end: End: arms extended above the chest.
notes: Bench, chest-press machine and push-away presses. Incline: param bench_deg=30 (arms keep pointing up in the room). Decline: bench_deg=-15.

name: Vertical press
twin_start: Start: hands at the shoulders, elbows bent about 55 degrees.
twin_end: End: arms extended overhead.
notes: Overhead and shoulder presses, standing or seated (seated: torso_lean=-5, hip 100, knee 100 via param seated=yes).

name: Push-up
twin_start: Start: body in a straight line, arms extended.
twin_end: End: chest lowered, elbows bent about 80 degrees.
notes: Start is the top of the movement; the body stays in one line.

name: Dip
twin_start: Start: arms extended, body supported on the hands.
twin_end: End: body lowered, elbows bent about 85 degrees.

name: Chest fly
twin_start: Start: arms open out to the sides, elbows slightly bent.
twin_end: End: arms brought together in front of the chest.
notes: Front view; the lying and cable versions are drawn standing so the arc can be read.

name: Rear fly
twin_start: Start: arms in front of the body, elbows slightly bent.
twin_end: End: arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
notes: Front view; bent-over versions are drawn upright (simplification).

name: Lateral raise
twin_start: Start: arms by the sides, elbows slightly bent.
twin_end: End: arms raised out to the sides to shoulder height.

name: Front raise
twin_start: Start: arms by the sides.
twin_end: End: arms raised in front to shoulder height.

name: Y raise
twin_start: Start: arms low in front of the body.
twin_end: End: arms raised overhead in a Y shape.

name: Shrug
twin_start: Start: shoulders relaxed, arms hanging.
twin_end: End: shoulders lifted toward the ears.
notes: No joint angle changes (the 12 joints cannot express shoulder-blade lift); the renderer draws a short lift arrow at the shoulders.

name: Upright row
twin_start: Start: arms hanging in front of the thighs.
twin_end: End: hands at chest height, elbows bent about 60 degrees and high.

name: Vertical pull (pulldown)
twin_start: Start: seated, arms extended overhead.
twin_end: End: bar pulled to the upper chest, elbows bent about 60 degrees.

name: Straight-arm pulldown / pullover
twin_start: Start: arms extended overhead.
twin_end: End: arms extended down by the thighs.
notes: Also used for pullovers; lying versions are drawn standing.

name: Pull-up / chin-up
twin_start: Start: hanging with arms extended.
twin_end: End: chin above the bar, elbows bent about 55 degrees.

name: Horizontal row
twin_start: Start: seated, arms extended in front.
twin_end: End: handle pulled to the torso, elbows bent about 65 degrees.

name: Bent-over row
twin_start: Start: hinged forward, arms hanging.
twin_end: End: weight pulled toward the torso, elbows bent about 80 degrees.

name: Hip hinge (Romanian deadlift, good morning)
twin_start: Start: standing tall.
twin_end: End: hips pushed back, torso leaning forward about 65 degrees, knees slightly bent.

name: Deadlift
twin_start: Start: weight at the floor, knees and hips bent, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees.
twin_end: End: standing tall with the weight at the thighs.
notes: Start is the bottom of the movement.

name: Squat
twin_start: Start: standing tall.
twin_end: End: hips and knees bent about 70 degrees, torso leaning forward about 35 degrees.
notes: Back, front, goblet, hack and machine squats share this typical shape.

name: Lunge / split squat
twin_start: Start: standing tall.
twin_end: End: front hip and knee bent about 90 degrees, back knee bent about 90 degrees.
notes: Left is the front leg. The renderer may mirror it for a right-leg-forward variant.

name: Step-up
twin_start: Start: one foot on the step, knee bent about 90 degrees.
twin_end: End: standing tall on the step, other knee lifted.

name: Leg press
twin_start: Start: knees bent about 70 degrees, hips bent about 65 degrees.
twin_end: End: legs extended, knees almost straight.

name: Leg extension
twin_start: Start: seated, knees bent about 90 degrees.
twin_end: End: knees extended.

name: Leg curl
twin_start: Start: lying face down, legs extended.
twin_end: End: knees bent about 50 degrees, heels toward the hips.
notes: Lying (face down) shape; seated and ball or suspension versions are approximations.

name: Calf raise
twin_start: Start: heels lowered.
twin_end: End: heels raised high, standing on the toes.
notes: Seated version: param seated=yes (hip 95, knee 95).

name: Biceps curl
twin_start: Start: arms extended by the sides.
twin_end: End: elbows bent about 40 degrees, hands at the shoulders.

name: Triceps pushdown
twin_start: Start: elbows by the sides, bent about 90 degrees.
twin_end: End: arms extended down.

name: Overhead triceps extension
twin_start: Start: arms overhead, elbows bent about 50 degrees.
twin_end: End: arms extended overhead.

name: Lying triceps extension
twin_start: Start: lying back, arms up, elbows bent about 80 degrees.
twin_end: End: arms extended above the chest.

name: Crunch / sit-up
twin_start: Start: lying on the back, knees bent.
twin_end: End: shoulders lifted off the floor, trunk curled up.

name: Leg raise
twin_start: Start: lying on the back, legs extended.
twin_end: End: legs raised, hips bent about 100 degrees.

name: Plank (hold)
twin_start: Start and end: body in a straight line on the forearms and toes.
notes: Static: start equals end. Used for front-on plank holds only.

name: Rotation / chop
twin_start: Start: arms raised to one side, torso turned.
twin_end: End: arms swept down across the body to the other side.
notes: torso_lean is used as a sideways lean here; true trunk rotation cannot be shown with these 12 joints.

name: Pallof press
twin_start: Start: hands at the chest, elbows bent about 90 degrees.
twin_end: End: arms extended in front; torso stays still.

name: Carry / walk with weight
twin_start: Start: walking, left leg forward, weight held by the sides.
twin_end: End: walking, right leg forward.

name: Hip thrust / glute bridge
twin_start: Start: upper back on the bench or floor, hips lowered.
twin_end: End: hips raised until the trunk and thighs are in line.

name: Back extension
twin_start: Start: bent forward at the hips, torso about 60 degrees.
twin_end: End: torso raised in line with the legs.

name: Jump
twin_start: Start: crouched with arms swung back.
twin_end: End: body fully extended in the air, arms up.
notes: Landing is the reverse of the start; sideways jumps are not covered.

name: Mountain climber
twin_start: Start: plank position, left knee drawn toward the chest.
twin_end: End: right knee drawn toward the chest.

name: Jump rope
twin_start: Start: knees slightly bent, hands by the hips.
twin_end: End: small hop, toes pushing off the floor.

name: Battle rope wave
twin_start: Start: athletic half squat, left arm low, right arm raised.
twin_end: End: left arm raised, right arm low.

name: Walk / run
twin_start: Start: right knee forward, left arm forward.
twin_end: End: left knee forward, right arm forward.
notes: Also used for the elliptical and high-knee style drills.

name: Cycling
twin_start: Start: left pedal at the top, right at the bottom.
twin_end: End: right pedal at the top, left at the bottom.

name: Rowing machine stroke
twin_start: Start: catch, knees bent about 50 degrees, arms extended.
twin_end: End: finish, legs extended, handle at the ribs, leaning back slightly.

name: Ski erg pull
twin_start: Start: standing tall, arms overhead.
twin_end: End: hinged forward, hands pulled down past the hips.

name: Rollout
twin_start: Start: kneeling, wheel or bar under the shoulders.
twin_end: End: body stretched out long, arms overhead, hips still bent slightly.

name: Dead bug
twin_start: Start: lying on the back, arms up, hips and knees bent about 90 degrees.
twin_end: End: one leg and the opposite arm lowered toward the floor.

name: Triceps kickback
twin_start: Start: hinged forward, upper arm back, elbow bent about 90 degrees.
twin_end: End: arm extended behind the body.

name: Clean
twin_start: Start: weight at the floor, knees and hips bent, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees.
twin_end: End: standing tall with the weight racked at the shoulders, elbows bent about 35 degrees.
notes: Only the pull and catch are drawn; the dip and the foot movement are not.

name: Side bend
twin_start: Start: standing tall, weight held at one side.
twin_end: End: torso bent sideways about 30 degrees.
notes: Front view; torso_lean is a sideways lean here.

name: Kneeling or standing cable crunch
twin_start: Start: kneeling upright, hands by the head.
twin_end: End: trunk curled forward and down, hips still.

name: Jumping jack
twin_start: Start: feet together, arms by the sides.
twin_end: End: feet apart, arms overhead.
notes: Front view; here hip is the sideways spread of the leg (0 = legs together).

name: Slam
twin_start: Start: standing tall, ball held overhead.
twin_end: End: hinged forward, ball slammed to the floor.

name: Lateral lunge
twin_start: Start: standing tall, feet together.
twin_end: End: stepped wide to the left, left knee bent about 95 degrees, right leg straight.
notes: Front view; here hip is the sideways spread of the leg (0 = legs together).
